טבלה: בירור ויישוב תביעה
This table details the process for handling and settling insurance claims related to property or bodily harm, specifically third-party claims under a Harel policy. It outlines the steps taken by the company to assess the claim and gather necessary information.
ממדים: Stages in the claim process, Actions taken by Harel (the insurance company)
